title: Split Fiction
description: Split Fiction is a two-player cooperative action-adventure by Hazelight Studios. Writers Mio and Zoe become trapped in a simulation built from their contrasting science-fiction and fantasy stories, forcing them to cooperate through rapidly changing mechanics, platforming, action, and puzzle sequences. The Nintendo Switch 2 version supports cooperative play and Friend's Pass features.

gameplayPillars.title: Spectacle and Movement
gameplayPillars.description: Platforming, vehicles, bosses, and cinematic action constantly reshape the pacing.

worldSummary: Mio's science-fiction ideas and Zoe's fantasy stories collide inside a machine that steals creative ideas, creating shifting worlds the pair must escape.

storyChapters.title: Trapped in the Machine
storyChapters.body: Writers Mio and Zoe are pulled into a technology designed to extract their creative ideas, trapping them inside simulated worlds based on their fiction.

storyChapters.title: Sci-Fi and Fantasy Collide
storyChapters.body: The pair jump between radically different science-fiction and fantasy scenarios, relying on complementary co-op mechanics unique to each chapter.

storyChapters.title: Escape Through Cooperation
storyChapters.body: To break free, Mio and Zoe must learn to trust one another, confront personal fears reflected by their stories, and overcome the system controlling the simulations.
